Monsoon Activity Intensifies Across India, Bringing Rain and Thunderstorms

Monsoon activity has intensified across several Indian states, with forecasts predicting rain and thunderstorms for multiple districts over the next five days. In Chhattisgarh, increased monsoon activity is expected to bring rain and lightning to all districts. Meanwhile, Uttarakhand is experiencing a strong monsoon onset with rain expected until July 6, accompanied by a significant drop in temperature.
